question:
Select the set of classes the relationship among which is best illustrated by the following Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76bf2dc3a4cfc932eee287350823677fd2c6dc4b8f4d2f6c3762865801f35763.png]
solution:
The Venn diagram representation of **Lawyers, Mothers, Sisters is** shown below

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bc0d99d3159a10aaca5077cb864885b0052b09d85767e7ce66bda8aa3ef92a5.png] 

**Here, A lawyer should be a mother and a sister.**

**A mother should be a lawyer and a sister.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 4".**
